state: # OPE-425 — hand-verified aliases for place names our venue data uses that the
# Census place file does NOT contain.
# This file is deliberately SMALL and deliberately hand-written, which is the
# opposite of the rule for `ne-locations.tsv`. The distinction matters:
#   the UNIVERSE must be complete and machine-sourced — a partial municipality
#   list fails silently and drops inventory nobody notices;
#   the ALIASES are a mapping from OUR OWN messy strings onto that universe.
#   There is no authoritative file for "what did a submitter mean when they
#   typed Oquossoc", so every row here is a judgement, and the honest way to
#   hold judgements is one per line where a reviewer can check them.
# Census does not carry these: Oquossoc and Hyannis are not CDPs in the 2023
# place file at all, and several of the rest are postal names rather than
# statistical places. Verified individually against the town they sit in.
# ⚠️ NOT listed here, on purpose — left for the OPE-421 report rather than
# resolved on a guess:
#   MA Cape Cod    — a region, not a municipality. The venue row IS the defect.
# (CT Mystic is not here either, but for the opposite reason: it straddles
# Stonington and Groton, so a hand-picked parent would be wrong half the time —
# and it turns out not to need one, because Census carries "Mystic CDP" as a
# statistical place in its own right. It resolves from the universe file.)
